evaluation: 30 training-participant LOSO folds; classifier fitted on all trials of 29 source people; held-out person's first60 original-order trials excluded from scoring for every method
target_calibration: first60 original-order post-cue covariance matrices, labels unavailable to alignment; reference frozen for all later trials; no future reference updates
preprocessing: same v1 causal trial processing and 0.5-2.5s task window; new pre-cue baseline -1.0 to0.0s,250 samples; no delay compensation or future data
log_power_ratio: log(max(task sample variance,1e-12)/max(pre-cue sample variance,1e-12)), 8-12 and18-26Hz, eight fixed channels,16 dimensions; not percentage ERD
alignment: mean first60 trace-normalized 8-30Hz task covariance; Rreg=0.9*R+0.1*I/8; W=Rreg^(-1/2); congruence transform W*C*W.T followed by trace normalization; source reference also uses own first60
classifier: train-fold-only StandardScaler then LDA lsqr shrinkage auto; no parameter search
bad_trial_policy: retain all original complete finite trials and all author flags; abort on invalid structure, do not silently exclude subjects or trials
primary_metric: mean held-out participant balanced accuracy on same later trials
uncertainty: participant bootstrap10000 draws; paired difference versus CSP_LDA; Bonferroni98.3333% paired bootstrap intervals for three candidate comparisons are exploratory uncertainty, not a final population guarantee
selection: highest mean BA among candidates passing all three conditions; otherwise stop this four-condition diagnosis; no extra windows, bands, reference sizes or classifiers after scores
confirmation: do not read former10 development or12 confirmation EEGs this run; passing only nominates a frozen candidate for later independent evaluation, never automatic promotion
